blurb: Arapahoe Flight Club offers helicopter and fixed-wing flight training programs including career track programs for private pilot through instructor ratings, and accelerated multi-engine courses. They also provide helicopter tours showcasing Colorado Springs landmarks. The club operates a fleet of aircraft including Robinson R44 helicopters and Diamond DA-40 and DA-42 airplanes.
